name: Ako's Treasure: Location 2
desc: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the second part.

desc.text:
This picture was left behind by Ako Domeki and company.
The secret of where the treasure is hidden... It was split into four parts and placed amidst the reefs of the four large islands, and this is the second part.
Make a circle with a radius twenty-two large boat-lengths long with this place as its center...
The treasure is hidden where the four circles meet.
